description: Audits AI-generated documents, NotebookLM exports, and Google Drive research files for factual gaps, missing production constraints, outdated information, and unverified claims. Runs web search to fill each gap. Rebuilds a corrected version in the target brand voice with [SOURCED]/[GENERATED] tagging throughout. Activate when user says: "this has gaps", "audit this NLM doc", "there's missing info", "surface the gaps", "fact-check this", "rebuild with real sources", "correct this article", "AI content needs verification", "update with current info", "notebooklm export needs work", "the AI got this wrong", "what's missing here", "this is incomplete", "the doc is shallow", or uploads a Drive or NLM doc asking for a corrected or improved version. FAIL if rebuilt output ships without web search on top 3 gaps. FAIL if CLAIMS/GAPS footers omitted. FAIL if [SOURCED]/[GENERATED] tags missing.
